app.title: gpuvis: GPU Trace Visualizer
app.author: luu
app.description: GPU trace visualizer for Vulkan and OpenGL that can display call stacks, resource usage, and timeline data.
proposed_tests: Clone repo and run ./build.sh to build the binary
Run gpuvis --help to ensure CLI options are available
Run gpuvis with a sample .vktrace file and verify that a GUI window opens
Measure binary size and startup time
Check that the rendered timeline matches expected frame boundaries
